name: qwen3.8-27b-nvfp4
about: Qwen3.8-27B quantised by NVIDIA to NVFP4 (MLP layers) and FP8 (attention), with nvidia-modelopt. Apache-2.0. 21.9 GB against 30.9 GB for Qwen's FP8, so it fits a 32 GB card; NVFP4 runs natively only on Blackwell (RTX PRO 4500, RTX 5090); on the A100, the default card, vLLM needs a fallback path, and whether it serves there at all is part of the test. The question it answers: does the leading model keep its accuracy at a quarter of the memory and cost. Same settings as the qwen3.8-27b profile.
cards: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition
